senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (वेटति)
1 To sound.
2 To curse.
(इ) विटि r. 10th cl. (विण्टयति)
To decay.

m. (-टः)
1 A catamite, a pathic.
2 A rogue, a cheat.
3 An attendant on a dissolute character or courtezan.
4 A paramour, a gallant.
5 A mountain.
6 The Khayar tree, (Mimosa catechu.)
7 A medicinal salt: see विडल्वण.
8 A rat.
9 The orange tree.
10 A branch and its shoot.
E.
विट to sound, aff. क.

mn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्कं)
A dove-cot, an aviary.
E.
वि variously, टकि to bind, aff. घञ्; also with कन् added विटङ्कक.

mn. (-पः-पं)
1 The branch of a tree with its new sprout or shoot.
2 A new shoot.
3 A branch.
4 Expansion, spreading.
5 A clump, a cluster.
6 The perinæum or septum of the scrotum.
m. (-पः)
The keeper of pathics.
E.
विट a branch, &c., and पा to cherish, aff. क, or विट to sound, Uṇādi aff. अप, with the radical vowel unchanged.

m. (-पी)
1 A tree.
2 The large Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.)
E.
विटप a branch or shoot, and इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
A medicinal salt: see विट.

f. (-का)
A kind of bird, (probably a variety of the Turdus Salica of Buchannan.)
E.
विट् from विष् fæces, and कारिका working.

m. (-रः)
A fetid Mimosa.
E.
विट् fæces, and खदिर Mimosa catechu.

m. (-रः)
The tame or village hog.
E.
विट् filth, ordure, and चर who goes.

n. (-ण्यं)
Goods, merchandise.
E.
विट् a Vaiśya, and पण्य wares.

m. (-तिः)
1 A son-in-law, a daughter's husband.
2 A head merchant.
E.
विश् a Vaiśya, &c., and पति master.

n. (-णं)
A fetid salt: see विड.
E.
विट् ordure, लवण salt.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Constipation.
E.
विट्, and सङ्ग aggregate.

f. (-का)
A bird, a sort of thrush; a variety of the bird, usually though inaccurately called Maina in Bengal.
E.
विट् fæces, and सारिका the same bird, or another species of the same.

f. (-का)
1 The betel plant, (Piper betel.)
2 The preparation of the Areca nut with spices and chunam, and enveloped in the leaf of the Piper betel, Betel, Paun.
3 A tye, a fastening.
E.
वि before इट् to go, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form; also वीटि or वीटी.
